```{python}
from bike_routes.charts import (
    display_light_and_dark,
    network_size_chart,
    yearly_miles_chart,
)

routes = RouteSnapshotRepository().load()
```

## Miles added by year

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
display_light_and_dark(yearly_miles_chart(routes))
```

## Network size

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
display_light_and_dark(network_size_chart(routes))
```
